headline: Delta Air Lines (DAL) Stock Gets Fair Value Boost After Q2 Spurs Analyst Target Hikes
summary: The fair value estimate for Delta Air Lines has shifted from US$81.81 to US$105.52, a change of about 29% that moves closer to the higher end of recent Street price target ranges. Analysts linking this move to Delta’s recent Q2 results and commentary point to execution on earnings, margin structure, and the role of premium and loyalty driven revenue streams in supporting the updated targets.
